# Cove 1.8.0
**Talk to Claude** - Hold fn (🌐), speak, and release to send. Cove shows your transcript and streams Claude Code’s answer into the island. - Ask a follow-up within five minutes to continue the conversation. Esc cancels listening. - Choose Claude’s working folder in Settings → AI agents → Talk to Claude. - Optional read-aloud replies and automatic file edits, both off by default. Requests that need approval can continue in Terminal. - Microphone and speech recognition permissions are requested on first use. Recognition runs on-device when supported. Accessibility lets the fn shortcut work while other apps are active. - Quick fn taps and fn used as a modifier do not start listening.
This update keeps your existing settings and updates Cove in place.
